title: The Complete Persepolis: Volumes 1 and 2
author: Marjane Satrapi
current_text: Chicago Public Schools ordered The Complete Persepolis: Volumes 1 and 2 removed from its curriculum for 7th graders. The Complete Persepolis: Volumes 1 and 2 was removed from middle school libraries in Wilson County.

sources.quote: Author Marjane Satrapi 's graphic novel series — "Persepolis I," "Persepolis II" and "The Complete Persepolis" — was at the center of an uproar Friday following orders from Chicago Public Schools to remove it from the CPS curriculum for 7th graders.
sources.title: 'Persepolis' Ban by CPS Boosts Sales at Local Bookstores - Lincoln Square - Chicago - DNAinfo

sources.quote: It also includes Dr. Seuss’ Wacky Wednesday, which was removed from elementary school libraries, plus Sherman Alexie’s The Absolutely True Diary of a Part-Time Indian, Erika L. Sánchez’s I Am Not Your Perfect Mexican Daughter and Marjane Satrapi’s The Complete Persepolis, which were removed from middle school libraries.
